reply: Thank you for explaining that you returned an item in store before the pay-later order finished processing, and that the return has not been matched to the charge. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the merchant's return confirmation with the transaction ID and receipt, and send it in writing with your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that online loan searches sent you to a local store, where you were declined in person without seeing the information used. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the specific reasons for the decision and a copy of the notice you were told would be mailed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you set up autopay to clear your balance within the interest-free period and were assured no penalty would apply, but you received a bill for deferred interest. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep your autopay records and note of the call, and ask in writing for the interest calculation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was closed without a reason while over $2,000.00 in rewards remained, and that your emails have not been answered. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the rewards team. Please keep the emails and screenshots of your rewards balance, and send a written request asking how the rewards will be handled. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $750.00 e-gift card is declined at every merchant you try and cannot be added to a digital wallet. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the purchase confirmation and a list of declined attempts, and ask in writing for the reason and how the balance can be used or returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the $500.00 prepaid card you loaded in a store does not work, and that you sent the documents requested but have not received a refund. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the prepaid card team. Please keep the receipt, the card and your case number, and ask in writing for the status of the refund. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your benefits card was frozen for possible fraud and that you cannot access your money after sending your license. We are sorry for the hardship this is causing. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the prepaid card team. Please keep proof of when you sent your documents, and ask in writing for the status of your case. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that every time you try to order your free prepaid card online, the page shows an error after you accept the agreement. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the prepaid card team. Please keep screenshots of the error, and ask in writing for the card to be ordered for you another way. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cannot reset your benefits card PIN and were told to email sensitive documents to an incorrect address. We understand your concern and the hardship of being without funds. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the prepaid card team. Please confirm any address before sending documents, and ask in writing for the PIN reset steps. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $750.00 in fraudulent transactions nearly emptied your account, and that you still have not received your money back after sending three forms. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep copies of each form and the transaction numbers, and ask in writing for the status and expected timeline. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your eGift card shows a balance but is declined even when you try amounts below its value. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the email and a list of the declined attempts, and ask in writing for the reason and how the balance can be used. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $1,000.00 gift card from your employer is declined everywhere, even with purchases well below the balance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the card and a list of where it was declined, and ask in writing for the reason and how the balance can be used. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that information about your student loan on your credit report is inaccurate. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each specific error and include supporting documents in your dispute, and ask the servicer in writing to correct anything it reported in error. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your student loan payment increased by $400.00 without an explanation, and that you have received conflicting answers after long holds. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please send a written request for the calculation behind the new payment and your repayment options. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have always paid your private student loans on time to protect your co-signer, but you cannot get help lowering the interest rate. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing about rate reduction, co-signer release and any hardship options. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a private student loan is reported with a $400.00 past due balance that you believe has not been verified. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please ask the servicer in writing for documents supporting the balance and dates, and dispute any inaccurate details with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that within one week you were told your monthly payment would be $320.00 and then $1,000.00, which matters for your PSLF plan. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep both letters, and ask in writing which payment amount and repayment plan are correct. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $330.00 payment was taken from your bank account but not credited to your loan. We understand your frustration after a long call. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the bank statements you uploaded, and ask in writing for the payment to be traced and credited by its original date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received two past due notices even though you are on auto-debit and have paid extra. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your bank records of each auto-debit, and ask in writing for confirmation that your account is current. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have asked for help discharging this student loan account since 2016 and that the account is now behind. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the discharge options available to you and the documents needed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your online payments keep being reversed, even though your bank confirms your details are correct. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep records of each reversed payment and your bank's confirmation, and ask in writing for the cause and for how phone payments are allocated. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your truck was totaled, you have received only part of the refunds owed for the loan overpayment and cancelled products. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the payoff letter and cancellation paperwork, and ask in writing for a breakdown of each refund. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your buyback request was denied even though your vehicle has had the same air conditioning problem repaired more than five times. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep all repair orders and the warranty, and ask in writing for the reasons the request was denied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you voluntarily surrendered a leased vehicle after an insurance problem, and that you dispute how it is reported. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep your surrender records and dispute the entry with the credit reporting companies. If you disagree with the result, you can add a statement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your lease-end inspection showed $0.00 owed, but you later received a bill for excess wear without any details. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lease team. Please keep the inspection results, and ask in writing for the photos and itemized charges, and for the status of your overpayment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for the internal deal sheet showing the lender's rate before the dealer markup, and that the request was refused. We understand why you want this information. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send your request in writing, and ask for any documents about your interest rate that can be provided. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that both cars you bought had problems, and that the trade-in was described as a vehicle you never owned. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep your sales contracts, trade-in documents and repair records, and ask in writing for copies of the loan paperwork. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your car burned and insurance paid its value, you agreed to a hardship plan, but your payments are not reducing the balance shown. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for a copy of the hardship agreement and a payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle loan has been paid off and that you were told the credit report would update at the end of the month. We understand you want it updated quickly. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep the payoff confirmation, and check your credit reports after the next reporting cycle. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that, as co-buyer on a joint account, you dispute the full $22,000.00 charge-off being reported to you. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep the contract and the earlier response, and dispute the entry with the credit reporting companies, explaining your concerns. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
